## Services (7 Total)

### 1. Turbine Erection & Commissioning (srv_1)
Expert erection and commissioning for steam turbines, pumps, compressors, fans, condensers, EOT cranes, and steam/water/air pipeline work. Includes complete OEM coordination and documentation.

**Capabilities:**
- Steam turbines, pumps, compressors, fans, condensers
- EOT cranes, steel structure & pipe line work
- Construction supervision to OEM specs & applicable standards
- Coordination with OEM throughout all phases
- Complete documentation for handover to operations
- Development & execution of pre-commissioning procedures
- Assist with start-up and fine tuning to operational needs

**OEMs Covered:** Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss India, Maxwatt

### 2. Turnkey Overhauling & Maintenance (srv_2)
Executed by ex-OEM engineers from Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss, and more. Includes pre-shutdown planning, on-site condition reporting, comprehensive spares management, and 24x7 emergency troubleshooting.

**Capabilities:**
- Pre-shutdown planning with detailed scope of rotating equipment
- Onsite inspection of stocked spare parts with shortfall reports
- Ex-OEM engineers: Triveni, Belliss, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, BHEL, Siemens, KKK, ABB
- All clearances, gaps and sizes measured and recorded
- Condition report with recommendations for each component
- Turnkey basis: tools, tackles, consumables & manpower provided
- 24x7 emergency response with engineers at multiple locations

**OEMs Covered:** Triveni, Belliss India, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, BHEL, Siemens, KKK, ABB

### 3. Precision Reverse Engineering (srv_3)
PMI-verified reverse engineering using 3D laser scanners, CMM, and copying lathes for turbines from 5 kW to 27 MW. Generate full manufacturing drawings with tolerances, concentricity, pre/post heat treatment specs.

**Capabilities:**
- 3D Laser Scanner, CMM & Coordinate Measuring Machine at site/workshop
- PMI testing for exact identification of material composition
- Copying lathe for precision dimensional replication
- Engineering drawings with tolerances, finish, parallelity, concentricity
- Pre/post heat treatment specifications included
- Rough machining, pre-final and final machining drawings
- Covers turbines from 5 kW to 27 MW (Back Pressure or Condensing)
- Single/Multi stage, Drive or Power, Horizontal or Vertical

**OEMs Covered:** Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, All Makes

### 4. Dynamic Balancing & Rotor Machining (srv_4)
Precision rotor machining (grinding, polishing, journal undersizing) at workshop lathes, plus ISO/API standard dynamic balancing from 50 to 2000 kg with full compliance reporting.

**Capabilities:**
- Journal grinding & polishing with minimum undersizing technique
- Labyrinth portion machining on precision lathes
- Rotor set concentric at all portions before machining
- Dynamic balancing 50-2000 kg to ISO/API standards
- Balancing machines with latest vibration monitoring systems
- Mechanical and electrical run-out identification pre-installation
- Comprehensive balancing report documenting ISO/API compliance

**OEMs Covered:** All Turbine Makes

### 5. Lube Oil Flushing (srv_5)
ISO-compliant flushing using purpose-built mobile centrifuge filter systems. Achieves maximum cleanliness and de-watering following construction or during scheduled maintenance.

**Capabilities:**
- Purpose-built mobile centrifuge filter system
- Targets system cleanliness per ISO 4406:99 standards
- Oil sampling and reporting undertaken per ISO standards
- Effective for post-construction and scheduled maintenance
- Superior de-watering and contamination removal
- Solid particle removal from 4 to 25 microns
- System flow rates handled up to 6,000 l/min

### 6. Machine Alignment (srv_6)
Expert machine alignment using latest technology to eliminate misalignment, one of the primary causes of equipment failure.

**Capabilities:**
- Turbine to gearbox & gearbox to mill gearbox alignment
- Fan, pump, alternator, induction generator alignment
- Machine levelling & pipe strain measurements on any frame size
- Fiberizor, shredder alignment
- Latest alignment technology for highest standards
- Detailed alignment reporting with exact results
- Covers any size machine frame in any location

### 7. Troubleshooting Service (srv_7)
Rapid on-site fault diagnosis for steam turbines experiencing vibration, bearing failure, governor instability, steam leakage, oil contamination, or unexpected trips. Ex-OEM engineers deploy with full diagnostic instrumentation.

**Capabilities:**
- High vibration — imbalance, misalignment, bearing wear, rub diagnosis
- Governor hunting, speed instability & overspeed trip investigation
- Bearing oil contamination — carbon ring seal & lube system analysis
- Steam gland leakage — labyrinth seal, packing & gland steam pressure issues
- Blade fouling, erosion & steam path efficiency loss analysis
- Unexpected trip investigation — oil pressure, temperature & control system faults
- 24x7 emergency deployment across India with all diagnostic equipment

**OEMs Covered:** Triveni, Siemens, BHEL, Belliss India, Maxwatt, Man Turbo, KKK, ABB

## Industries Served (7 Industries)

1. **Power Generation** (ind_1): 5 MW–27 MW thermal power plants. Steam turbine overhauling, erection, lube oil flushing, filter elements.
2. **Sugar Mills & Distilleries** (ind_2): Back-pressure turbines, Triveni/Belliss specialists, inter-season overhauling, crushing-season emergency support.
3. **Paper & Pulp Mills** (ind_3): Continuous-operation turbine maintenance, duplex basket strainers, expansion joints. Siemens, BHEL, Triveni.
4. **Oil & Gas** (ind_4): API 614/670 compliant products, PTFE-lined hoses, high-pressure hydraulic hoses, dynamic balancing.
5. **Petrochemical & Refineries** (ind_5): Metallic bellows expansion joints, high-temp PTFE products, ASME-code strainers, Inconel/Hastelloy bellows.
6. **Agro & Food Processing** (ind_6): Steam turbine maintenance, FDA-grade PTFE hoses, anti-vibration mounts, tank breather filters.
7. **Cement & Construction** (ind_7): Kiln gearbox lube oil filters, kiln exhaust expansion joints, crusher/mill anti-vibration mounts, abrasive media hoses.

## Technical Blog Articles (5 Articles)

### 1. The Complete Steam Turbine Overhauling Checklist for Plant Engineers
**Slug:** steam-turbine-overhauling-checklist | **Date:** 2026-03-15 | **Read Time:** 8 min
A practical, step-by-step checklist covering pre-shutdown planning, inspection protocols, clearance recording, and post-overhaul commissioning for steam turbines up to 27 MW. Covers 7 phases: pre-shutdown planning, shutdown & isolation, disassembly & inspection, workshop repairs, reassembly & alignment, lube oil flushing, and commissioning.

### 2. How Lube Oil Contamination Destroys Turbine Bearings — And How to Prevent It
**Slug:** lube-oil-contamination-turbine-bearings | **Date:** 2026-02-28 | **Read Time:** 6 min
Water ingress, solid particles, and oxidation are the three leading causes of premature turbine bearing failure. Covers each contamination type with solutions and filtration product recommendations.

### 3. Reverse Engineering Turbine Spares: How We Recreate Obsolete Components in India
**Slug:** reverse-engineering-turbine-spares-india | **Date:** 2026-01-20 | **Read Time:** 7 min
When OEM spare parts are unavailable or have 18-month lead times, reverse engineering offers a reliable alternative. Covers the 5-step process: component acquisition, 3D laser scanning, PMI material testing, engineering drawing generation, and machining & quality control.

### 4. Belliss & Morcom Turbine Common Faults — Field Guide for Indian Plants
**Slug:** belliss-morcom-turbine-common-faults-india | **Date:** 2026-03-18 | **Read Time:** 8 min
Common faults in Belliss & Morcom turbines widely used in Indian sugar mills: high vibration, governor hunting, steam gland leakage, and lube oil system faults. Practical diagnostic steps for each.

### 5. How to Read an ISO 4406 Lube Oil Cleanliness Report
**Slug:** iso-4406-lube-oil-cleanliness-guide | **Date:** 2026-04-05 | **Read Time:** 6 min
Explains ISO 4406:99 particle count codes, cleanliness targets for turbine bearing systems (16/14/11 per API 614), and when to act on deteriorating oil reports.
